author: Codex
scope: Default-off class/CPL condition matching and constant condition TYPEP/REQUIRE-TYPE through CCL CLASS-TYPEP. Whole condition construction, readers, class-table installation and image/READY remain open.
observations: O-19: The six explicit fixture callers are not dependency-closed. CLASS-TYPEP reaches %INITED-CLASS-CPL; UPDATE-CLASS and COMPUTE-CPL remain open. Require initialized CPLs; a NIL CPL can refuse with checked code 2.

O-20: Host-known condition classes exceed the eleven-name owner catalog. Missing runtime names refuse with checked code 12. Replace the fixture cons-cell catalog with actual native class-cell structures from the cross-dumped class table; do not keep a second class registry.

O-21: CPL matching is opt-in. Condition construction, readers and the 28-row mask registry retain their prior schemas; SIGNAL string and symbol designators remain refused. This acceptance covers only O-10 matching, not the complete condition system.
